parent_objective: audit bounded materialization before reset-validation design
blocked_by: M1861 materialized executable-v2 candidate artifacts require audit before reset validation
supersedes: direct reset validation from materialization without audit

public_gates: M1862 must audit materialized spec count caps duplicate keys labels and role coverage
M1862 must choose reset-validation design or materialization repair
M1862 must keep reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO promotion ranking and paper-level claims blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits bounded materialization artifacts and decides whether reset-validation design is admissible
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if materialized count exceeds caps
stop if duplicate keys are present
stop if labels enter actor inputs
stop if role coverage is too imbalanced for reset validation
fallback_plan: route to reset-validation design if materialization is clean
route to materialization repair if caps joins or labels fail
route to branch synthesis if materialization should stop

blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1862 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for reset-validation design or materialization repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; materialization audit is task-quality infrastructure.
history_necessity_tests: Audit must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1861 materialization artifacts only; no reset or rollout.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Any imbalance or shortage must be recorded rather than hidden by tuning.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, measured rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1861 materialization artifacts are clean enough to design reset validation.
success_criteria: audit records materialized spec count role coverage duplicate keys and guardrails
audit chooses next route without running reset rollout measured rollout training replay PPO ranking or paper-level claims
failure_criteria: audit reruns materialization or source mining
audit runs reset rollout training replay PPO or ranking
audit changes actor inputs reward dynamics or termination behavior
decision_rule: M1862 passes if it audits materialization and chooses the next route without reset, rollout, ranking, or paper-level claims.
